name: Caslon Compressed 1841
description: Narrow Roman capitals with fine hairlines, flat serifs and a recurved Q tail.
observed: Complete capitals from Two-Line Pica; compatible Great Primer supplies figures, punctuation and OE ligature.
reconstructed: No inferred visible characters. Spaces and digital spacing are new; lowercase input aliases the corresponding capitals.

sources.title: Specimen of printing types, Henry Caslon (1841), archive leaf 13, PDF page 14
sources.rights: 1841 British publication, public domain by age. Internet Archive metadata supplies Public Domain Mark 1.0; historical scan retained.

revival.author: Harold Lehmann
revival.notes: Native JP2 and exact quarter-turn derivative; explicit row selection, scale/baseline measurements and rigid rotation retained in source. No reconstructed letters.

character_set_notes: Complete observed capital alphabet and ten figures with available source symbols. Historical point sizes identify witnesses for one scalable design.
